text:
alexw: Heads-up — I want to rollforward slice-12 (reserved capacity + updated autoscale matrix) to prod today at 15:30 PT. Will be a staged activation across 3 regions. Who can own smoke and rollback?
marina: I can own smoke for us-east and eu-west. Will be available at 15:15 PT to run checks.
priya: I can do us-west. Also double-checking that the new autoscale thresholds are in config-store.
sam: I'll watch the rollout and be ready to flip the feature flag if anything degrades. Can we keep the old policy hot-fallback for 30m?
alexw: yes, fallback window 30m. Priya — config-store path is `infra/prod/autoscale/slice-12`. Please confirm the new CPU/RPS matrix matches the spreadsheet I linked earlier.
priya: confirmed — matrix matches. I pushed the policy under `infra/prod/autoscale/slice-12@v2`. SHA: `c3a9f2b`.
marina: notes for smoke tests below. I'll run these first in us-east-1: 
```
# smoke checklist
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE_TOKEN" https://api.prod.redwood/v1/health || echo "api fail"
redis-cli -h cache-prodeast PING || echo "redis fail"
kubectl --context=prod-east rollout status ds/gpu-pool -n inference || echo "k8s fail"
# generate a small 256-token infer to validate KV cache behavior
redwoodctl infer --model rdx-opus-7b --input-file smoke_prompt.txt --max-tokens 256 --region us-east-1
```
alexw: perfect. Devops bot will post the deployment job. Sam, keep the rollback play ready — steps are in playbook `deploy/rollback-slice.md`.
devops-bot: Deployment pipeline triggered: slice-12-activation by alexw. CI checks passed. Expected time 15:30 PT. Link: https://ci.redwood/pipelines/6789
priya: quick QA checklist — watch tail of `/var/log/inference/run.log` for any `OOM` or `kernel error` and monitor 95p latency on route `/v1/generate`.
marina: I'll capture traces in tracing-ui and annotate if increase >10% p95.
sam: pinging on-call infra in #eng-oncall for extra eyes during the 15:30 window.
alexw: small extra: we'll run a canary on 2% traffic for 10 minutes then 20% for 10 minutes before full activation. If any check fails, fallback to `slice-12@v1` and pause.
priya: understood. I'll post smoke results as short bullets here.
marina: also verifying that dedicated GPU quota bump has propagated — checking `gcloud compute reservations describe rdx-reserved-slice-12` now.
devops-bot: Canary stage started at 15:30 PT. Canary instances: 4 (us-east-1:2, us-west-1:1, eu-west-1:1).
marina: smoke us-east done — health ok, no error logs, p95 latency +4%. continuing to 20%. :thumbsup:
priya: smoke us-west done — redis ping ok, small transient 6% p95 increase but KV hit-rate stable.
sam: infra oncall confirmed no scheduler evictions seen.
alexw: thanks all. If anyone sees regression >10% p95 or any OOMs, call the rollback and tag me. Otherwise we'll move to full activation at ~15:50 PT after canary window.
marina: noted. I'll archive logs and link to thread when done.
priya: posting smoke artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood/smoke/slice-12/1863459801
alexw: great teamwork. Closing coordination here — will post final status after full activation. :rocket:
